Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1362
Claimant:
Crystal Morgan
Adjuster:
Valerie Rodriguez
August 21, 2023
Claim opened after the insured driver reported a low-speed head-on collision. The claimant is represented by
counsel, and all contact will go through the attorney's office from here.
August 27, 2023
The insured driver is named on the policy and the policy was in force for the period at issue. Nothing so far suggests
the reported damage existed before coverage began.
August 30, 2023
Claimant reports neck and back strain. The kind and force of the impact described fit that injury well. No earlier injury
to the same areas is known from the records we have.
November 20, 2023
Vehicle damage was inspected and is consistnet with the impact as described. A few older scratches are present,
and they may predate this collision, so they have been noted separately for the estimate.
December 29, 2023
Police records place the claimant in the vehicle at the scene. No independent witness to the collision itself has come
forward, and no photographs or separate accident report have been provided by anyone.
January 22, 2024
In the first call, the claimant described the direction of impact and the number of occupants in the car. In a later
conversation those details were different, and the claimant has not yet explained the change. Counsel has been
asked to clarify in writing.
March 11, 2024
Treatment has continued somewhat longer than is typical for this kind of injury. The treating provider's notes are
requested to confirm the reasons for the extended course of care.
March 15, 2024
File remains open pending the requested treatment notes, the written clarification on the impact details, and a review
of the scratches against the inspection photos. No liability or coverage decision has been made.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
